payload.credit_html: "The first deep-snouted tyrannosaur from Upper Cretaceous Ganzhou City of southeastern China"
payload.description_html: Fossil remains of Asiatyrannus xui (ZMNH M30360). (A) Skeletal outlines showing recovered elements in yellow color. The skeletal reconstruction is the proportional scaling of Teratophoneus curriei drawn by Scott Hartman from Loewen et al.; (B) the skull in right lateral view; (C) the caudal vertebrae in left lateral view; (D) the right femur in posterior view; (E) the right tibia and fibula in posterior view; (F) The distal portion of the right metatarsal III in medial view and metatarsal IV in anterior view; (G) the middle shaft of the left tibia and fibula in anterior view; (H) The middle shaft of the left metatarsals in anterior view. ft the fourth trochanter; ift iliofibularis tubercle; mt metatarsal.
